```{ojs}
{ // Dispatch an event to be able to get the value from js console and trigger a js event.
  window.livetest = test
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("livetest-change", { detail: test }))
  return test
}
// Then in JS console:

//   console.log("livetest changed:", e.detail)

livetest = Generators.observe((notify) => {
  const handler = (e) => notify(e.detail)
  window.addEventListener("livetest-change", handler)
  return () => window.removeEventListener("livetest-change", handler)
})
// Then in JS console:

livetest

livetest + 5
```

```{ojs}
ojsBridge = (id, value) => {
  const key = `ojs_${id}`;
  const eventName = `ojs:${id}:change`;

  // Push current OJS value out to regular JS
  window[key] = value;
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(eventName, { detail: value }));

  // Return an observable that can receive updates from JS/console
  return Generators.observe((notify) => {
    const handler = (e) => notify(e.detail);
    window.addEventListener(eventName, handler);

    // Initialize from current global if present
    if (key in window) notify(window[key]);

    return () => window.removeEventListener(eventName, handler);
  });
};

// viewof initialVar = Input.input(["Hi Brayden"])

viewof inputVar = Inputs.radio(["Hi World", "Hi Brayden"]);

testBridge = ojsBridge("bridgetest", inputVar);

md`Say hello from JS and OJS: ${testBridge}`;

// IN JS console:

// To get/watch value:

//   console.log("livetest changed:", e.detail)
// })

// To set value:
// window.ojs_bridgetest = "Hello World"
// window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("ojs:bridgetest:change", { detail: "Hello World" }))
```

# Observable input CSS regression checks

Use this section after changing `styles/observable-inputs.css` or the enhanced
multiselect. Check it at desktop width and again with a narrow browser window.

## Native Observable inputs

Check that labels, borders, hover/focus states, controls, and the native button
still match the Atlas styling. The plain custom button underneath should not
inherit the green Observable button hover style.

```{ojs}
nativeInputChecks = {
  const controls = [
    Inputs.text({ label: "Text input", value: "Atlas input" }),
    Inputs.select(["Kenya", "Tanzania", "Uganda"], {
      label: "Single select",
      value: "Kenya",
    }),
    Inputs.range([0, 100], {
      label: "Range",
      value: 40,
      step: 5,
    }),
    Inputs.radio(["Map", "Chart", "Table"], {
      label: "Radio group",
      value: "Map",
    }),
    Inputs.checkbox(["Crops", "Livestock"], {
      label: "Checkbox group",
      value: ["Crops"],
    }),
    Inputs.toggle({ label: "Toggle", value: true }),
    Inputs.textarea({
      label: "Textarea",
      value: "Nested divs should not receive global vertical padding.",
      rows: 3,
    }),
    Inputs.button("Native Observable button"),
  ];

  return html`<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:2rem;align-items:start;">${controls}</div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
customButtonCheck = html`<div style="margin:1rem 0 2rem;">
  <button type="button" style="padding:0.5rem 0.75rem;">Plain custom button</button>
</div>`;
```

# Canonical table and utility checks

The searchable and static examples should share the same Atlas table styling.
The first table should include search and zebra striping; the second should
render without a search control. The tooltip should work with hover and
keyboard focus, and the loader should use the shared spinner animation.

```{ojs}
import { atlasTable } from "/helpers/atlasTable.ojs";
import { makeTooltipLabel } from "/helpers/uiComponents.ojs";
import { loaderDiv } from "/helpers/std.ojs";

atlasTableCheckData = [
  { region: "Central", crop: "Beans", score: 72 },
  { region: "Eastern", crop: "Maize", score: 64 },
  { region: "Northern", crop: "Sorghum", score: 81 },
  { region: "Western", crop: "Rice", score: 58 },
];
```

```{ojs}
atlasSearchableTableCheck = atlasTable(atlasTableCheckData, {
  searchable: true,
  zebra: true,
  columns: ["region", "crop", "score"],
  format: { score: (value) => `${value}%` },
});
```

```{ojs}
atlasStaticTableCheck = atlasTable(atlasTableCheckData.slice(0, 2), {
  searchable: false,
  columns: ["region", "crop", "score"],
});
```

```{ojs}
atlasUtilityStyleCheck = {
  const loader = loaderDiv("atlas-loader-style-check");
  loader.style.setProperty("--atlas-loader-min-height", "8rem");

  return html`<div>
    <p>${makeTooltipLabel({
      labelText: "Keyboard-accessible tooltip",
      tooltipText: "This tooltip is styled once through ui-components.css.",
    })}</p>
    ${loader}
  </div>`;
}
```

## Enhanced multiselects

For each dropdown, verify:

- its width does not change as selections are added or removed;
- Select/Deselect All stays flush at the top;
- only the option list scrolls, with no text visible behind the action row;
- long selected labels truncate with an ellipsis;
- the controls wrap instead of overflowing at narrow viewport widths;
- Arrow keys move option focus, Space/Enter toggle, and Escape returns focus to
  the trigger;
- the French example uses localized action and empty-selection labels.

```{ojs}
import {
  atlasMultiSelect,
  enhancedMultiSelect,
} from "/helpers/enhancedMultiSelect.ojs";

makeEnhancedCheck = ({
  label,
  options,
  value = [],
  minWidth = "240px",
  maxWidth = "400px",
  language = "en",
  commit = "close",
} = {}) => {
  return atlasMultiSelect(options, {
    label,
    value,
    enableSelectAll: true,
    requireAtLeastOne: false,
    minWidth,
    maxWidth,
    language,
    commit,
  });
};
```

```{ojs}
enhancedInputChecks = {
  const shortOptions = ["Kenya", "Tanzania", "Uganda", "Rwanda", "Burundi"];
  const longOptions = Array.from(
    { length: 36 },
    (_, i) => `Administrative region ${String(i + 1).padStart(2, "0")} with a deliberately long label`,
  );

  const controls = [
    makeEnhancedCheck({
      label: "Typical selection",
      options: shortOptions,
      value: ["Kenya", "Tanzania"],
    }),
    makeEnhancedCheck({
      label: "Long labels and scrolling",
      options: longOptions,
      value: longOptions.slice(0, 8),
    }),
    makeEnhancedCheck({
      label: "Narrow configured width",
      options: longOptions.slice(0, 12),
      value: longOptions.slice(0, 3),
      minWidth: "200px",
      maxWidth: "320px",
    }),
    makeEnhancedCheck({
      label: "Libellés français",
      options: ["Kenya", "Tanzanie", "Ouganda"],
      language: "fr",
      value: [],
    }),
  ];

  return html`<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:2rem;align-items:flex-start;">${controls}</div>`;
}
```

The lower-level enhancer remains available when an input must be created or
bound first:

```{ojs}
advancedEnhancedCheck = {
  const input = Inputs.select(["One", "Two", "Three"], {
    label: "Advanced existing input",
    multiple: true,
    value: ["One"],
  });
  enhancedMultiSelect(input, {
    searchable: true,
    requireAtLeastOne: false,
  });
  return input;
}
```

The following checks exercise the DOM contract and commit timing without
requiring visual inspection. Commit timing is fixed: selecting an option must not
emit, and closing the menu emits once if anything changed while it was open.

```{ojs}
multiSelectBehaviorChecks = {
  const results = [];
  const check = (label, pass) => results.push({ label, pass: Boolean(pass) });
  const sandbox = document.createElement("div");
  sandbox.style.cssText = "position:fixed;left:-10000px;top:0;width:500px;";
  document.body.appendChild(sandbox);

  const immediate = atlasMultiSelect(["Alpha", "Beta"], {
    value: [],
    requireAtLeastOne: false,
    enableSelectAll: true,
  });
  sandbox.appendChild(immediate);
  let immediateEvents = 0;
  immediate.addEventListener("input", () => immediateEvents += 1);
  const immediateButton = immediate.querySelector("button");
  immediateButton.click();
  const immediateOption = immediate.querySelector('[role="option"]');
  immediateOption.click();

  check("selecting an option does not emit", immediateEvents === 0);
  check("trigger exposes expanded state", immediateButton.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true");
  check("options use listbox semantics", immediate.querySelector('[role="listbox"]')?.contains(immediateOption));
  check("all buttons have type=button", Array.from(immediate.querySelectorAll("button")).every((button) => button.type === "button"));

  immediateOption.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", {
    key: "ArrowDown",
    bubbles: true,
  }));
  check("ArrowDown moves option focus", document.activeElement === immediate.querySelectorAll('[role="option"]')[1]);

  document.activeElement.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", {
    key: "Escape",
    bubbles: true,
  }));
  check("Escape closes the menu", immediateButton.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "false");
  check("Escape returns trigger focus", document.activeElement === immediateButton);
  // Closing is the commit, however it is closed.
  check("Escape commits the pending change", immediateEvents === 1);

  const deferred = atlasMultiSelect(["Alpha", "Beta"], {
    value: [],
    requireAtLeastOne: false,
  });
  sandbox.appendChild(deferred);
  let deferredEvents = 0;
  deferred.addEventListener("input", () => deferredEvents += 1);
  deferred.atlasMultiSelect.open();
  deferred.querySelector('[role="option"]').click();
  check("selection while open is deferred", deferredEvents === 0);
  deferred.atlasMultiSelect.close();
  check("close emits exactly once", deferredEvents === 1);
  deferred.atlasMultiSelect.open();
  deferred.atlasMultiSelect.close();
  check("close with no change emits nothing", deferredEvents === 1);

  const localized = atlasMultiSelect(["Un", "Deux"], {
    value: [],
    requireAtLeastOne: false,
    enableSelectAll: true,
    language: "fr",
  });
  sandbox.appendChild(localized);
  check("empty label is localized", localized.querySelector("button span")?.textContent === "Aucune sélection");
  check("action labels are localized", Array.from(localized.querySelectorAll(".button-container button"), (button) => button.textContent).join("|") === "Tout sélectionner|Tout désélectionner");

  const limited = atlasMultiSelect(["One", "Two"], {
    value: [],
    maxSelections: 1,
    requireAtLeastOne: false,
    enableSelectAll: true,
  });
  sandbox.appendChild(limited);
  const limitedActions = Array.from(
    limited.querySelectorAll(".button-container button"),
    (button) => button.textContent,
  );
  check("Select All is hidden when selections are limited", !limitedActions.includes("Select All"));
  check("valid bulk actions remain available", limitedActions.join("|") === "Deselect All");

  const nativeSelect = deferred.querySelector("select");
  const addedOption = document.createElement("option");
  addedOption.value = "Gamma";
  addedOption.textContent = "Gamma <safe>";
  nativeSelect.appendChild(addedOption);
  await new Promise((resolve) => window.setTimeout(resolve, 0));
  check("option mutations rebuild the list", deferred.querySelectorAll('[role="option"]').length === 3);
  const addedRow = deferred.querySelectorAll('[role="option"]')[2];
  check("option labels remain text", addedRow?.textContent.includes("Gamma <safe>") && !addedRow.querySelector("*:not(span)"));

  [immediate, deferred, localized, limited].forEach((input) => {
    input.atlasMultiSelect.destroy();
  });
  sandbox.remove();

  const list = document.createElement("ul");
  results.forEach(({ label, pass }) => {
    const item = document.createElement("li");
    item.textContent = `${pass ? "PASS" : "FAIL"} — ${label}`;
    item.style.color = pass
      ? "var(--atlas-color-primary)"
      : "var(--atlas-color-focus)";
    list.appendChild(item);
  });
  return list;
}
```

# Canonical TOC and hero checks

The floating TOC should be rendered by the `atlas-toc` web component, include
the H1 and H2 headings on this page, and omit the circular hero title. When
there is not enough room beside the page, a **Regression checks** button should
open the TOC as an overlay. Resize the window below 900px and verify that both
the panel and its button hide cleanly.

Also check that only the active H1 section's indented H2 entries are visible,
the active parent stays green while its child is current, the thin gold
indicator follows the exact active entry while scrolling, Escape and an outside
click close the overlay, and keyboard focus moves into the first link when the
overlay opens.

The hero should retain a circular white content area over the image, preserve
its proportions at narrow widths, and expose useful image alternative text.

```{ojs}
import { atlasTOC } from "/helpers/toc.ojs";
import { atlasHero } from "/helpers/hero.js";
import { atlasHero as legacyAtlasHero } from "/helpers/uiComponents.ojs";

atlasTocCompatibilityCheck = atlasTOC({
  selector: "h1, h2",
  heading: "<b>Regression checks</b>",
  skip: ["notebook-title", "appendix", "source-code"],
});
```

```{ojs}
atlasHeroCheck = atlasHero({
  title: "Canonical Atlas hero",
  image: "/images/notebooks/roi.webp",
  group: "Shared components",
  alt: "Fields and trees in an agricultural landscape",
});
```

```{ojs}
legacyHeroCompatibilityCheck = {
  const hero = legacyAtlasHero(
    "Legacy positional API",
    "/images/default_crop.webp",
  );
  return html`<p>
    Legacy wrapper returns the canonical hero:
    <strong>${hero.classList.contains("atlas-hero") ? "yes" : "no"}</strong>
  </p>`;
}
```

# Safe shared rendering and CSV checks

The contribution title, names, and organizations below deliberately contain
HTML-special characters. They should render as ordinary text, with no markup
created from their values. Download the CSV and check that accented names open
correctly, quoted fields remain intact, and the columns follow the configured
order.

```{ojs}
import {
  downloadCsvButton,
  serializeCsv,
} from "/helpers/uiComponents.ojs";
import {
  atlasCitation,
  atlasContributionSection,
} from "/helpers/citation.js";

csvSafetyCheckData = [
  {
    admin: "Côte d'Ivoire",
    region: "North, \"Central\"",
    note: "First line\nSecond line",
  },
  {
    admin: "São Tomé & Príncipe",
    region: "Água Grande",
    note: "Accented administrative name",
  },
];
```

```{ojs}
csvDownloadCheck = downloadCsvButton(csvSafetyCheckData, {
  filename: "atlas-csv-regression.csv",
  label: "Download CSV regression",
  columns: ["admin", "region", "note"],
});
```

```{ojs}
csvFormatCheck = {
  const csv = serializeCsv(csvSafetyCheckData, {
    columns: ["admin", "region", "note"],
  });

  return html`<p>
    UTF-8 BOM: <strong>${csv.charCodeAt(0) === 0xfeff ? "yes" : "no"}</strong>;
    CRLF records: <strong>${csv.includes("\r\n") ? "yes" : "no"}</strong>
  </p>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
safeContributionCheck = atlasContributionSection(
  {
    authors: [{ name: "Amina <Researcher> & Co.", orgs: [2, 1] }],
    developers: [{ name: "Jean \"Builder\"", orgs: [1] }],
    organizations: {
      1: "R&D <Lab>",
      2: "Côte d'Ivoire \"Atlas\"",
    },
  },
  atlasCitation("ROI <Climate> & \"Food\""),
);
```

Optional contributor profile links. Only `http(s)` is allowed through, so the

# Canonical administrative selector checks

The shared selector is `helpers/adminSelectors.ojs`. The selection lives in that
module, one cell per level, and every control rendered anywhere on the page binds
to those same cells. Check that:

- changing a parent removes child selections that no longer belong to it — and
  that it does so for a level with **no control on screen** (the partial form
  below shows only country and region; pick a district in the full form first,
  then change the country in the partial one);
- the partial form and the full form stay in sync, and using the partial one
  never clears the district selection by itself;
- Côte d'Ivoire and names containing apostrophes work without affecting queries;
- region and district search works with or without accents;
- Select All is omitted when a level has a finite maximum;
- controls wrap cleanly in a narrow window;
- **each trigger label reports only what is actually selected.** Select All on
  countries, then check that regions reads "All regions" rather than a count of
  countries.

One whole-area convention throughout: a row whose own name is `null` means the
level is not narrowed. Single-select shows those rows ("Sub-Saharan Africa",
"Whole country", "All districts"); multi-select expresses the same thing by
selecting nothing, so it has no such rows.

```{ojs}
import {
  adminSelect,
  adminMultiSelect,
  adminSelections,
} from "/helpers/adminSelectors.ojs";

adminSelectorSummary = (selection) =>
  Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(selection).map(([level, rows]) => [
      level,
      rows.map((row) =>
        [row.iso3, row.admin1_name, row.admin2_name]
          .filter((part) => part != null)
          .join(" / ") || "whole area",
      ),
    ]),
  );
```

## All three levels, multi-select

```{ojs}
adminMultiSelect(0, 1, 2, {
  maxSelections: { admin0: 3, admin1: 8, admin2: 12 },
  selectAll: true,
  searchable: true,
})
```

## A partial form: country and region only

Bound to the same state. It has no district control, and must not be able to
disturb the district selection made above.

```{ojs}
adminMultiSelect(0, 1, { selectAll: true, searchable: true, langKey: "fr" })
```

## Single-select

```{ojs}
adminSelect(0, 1, 2)
```

```{ojs}
html`<pre>${JSON.stringify(adminSelectorSummary(adminSelections), null, 2)}</pre>`
```

# Atlas map helper regression checks

The canonical map helpers live in `helpers/atlasMap.ojs`. Check that the map
shows two adjacent regions, a green continuous legend, a dark outline around
the eastern region, and a tooltip on hover. The separate bivariate legend
should show a complete rotated three-by-three grid.

```{ojs}
import {
  makeBivariateLegend,
  makeChoropleth,
  mergeDataToBoundaries,
} from "/helpers/atlasMap.ojs";

atlasMapBoundaries = ({
  type: "FeatureCollection",
  features: [
    {
      type: "Feature",
      properties: { region_id: "west" },
      geometry: {
        type: "Polygon",
        coordinates: [[[30, -2], [34, -2], [34, 2], [30, 2], [30, -2]]],
      },
    },
    {
      type: "Feature",
      properties: { region_id: "east" },
      geometry: {
        type: "Polygon",
        coordinates: [[[34, -2], [38, -2], [38, 2], [34, 2], [34, -2]]],
      },
    },
  ],
});

atlasMapData = [
  { region_id: "west", region: "Western example", score: 28 },
  { region_id: "east", region: "Eastern example", score: 76 },
];

atlasMapFeatures = mergeDataToBoundaries({
  boundaries: atlasMapBoundaries,
  data: atlasMapData,
  boundaryKey: "region_id",
  dataKey: "region_id",
});
```

```{ojs}
atlasMapCheck = makeChoropleth({
  // Passing the feature array exercises vulnerability-style input.
  features: atlasMapFeatures.features,
  width: Math.min(width, 720),
  height: 320,
  projection: { type: "mercator" },
  fill: (d) => d.properties.data?.score,
  color: {
    type: "linear",
    domain: [0, 100],
    scheme: "YlGn",
    label: "Example score",
  },
  channels: {
    region: {
      label: "Region",
      value: (d) => d.properties.data?.region,
    },
    score: {
      label: "Score",
      value: (d) => d.properties.data?.score,
    },
  },
  tooltip: { region: true, score: true },
  adminHighlight: {
    filter: (d) => d.properties.region_id === "east",
    stroke: "#333",
    strokeWidth: 2.5,
  },
});
```
